scene: a small sealed bottle of Chateau Tamagne red wine standing behind a caesar salad with chicken, croutons, tomato and parmesan; no glass anywhere in frame
notes: The bottle is sealed and there is no glass, so nothing was poured and there is NO alcohol serving. Deliberately the negative of TG_95836: a rule that logs a drink whenever a bottle is in frame fails here, and one that only logs what was poured passes both. Under the current scorer a spurious wine row costs precision rather than recall, so this case is reported and not gated - it belongs in the set as evidence, not as a gate.
